title: Anthropic's public startup cohort was full
summary: The Claude for Startups page said the current cohort was full and not accepting new applications. Partner offers and VC-route credits were still described, but this was not a self-serve signup bonus on October 22.

title: Together AI no longer offered free trial credits
summary: Together AI's platform was prepaid at check and required a minimum credit purchase. The old 'free trial credits' advice in many blog posts is stale.

title: AWS Free Tier is a credit-and-plan model for new accounts
summary: New accounts get $100 in credits, can earn more, and can use a Free account plan for up to six months. The older twelve-month structure is not the right model for a new signup.

title: Google announced a one-year Gemini student offer
summary: Eligible U.S. college students could get Google AI Pro for a year; other markets received an AI Plus offer. This is a consumer plan, not Gemini API credits.

title: GitHub Models was fully retired
summary: The playground, model catalog, inference API, and bring-your-own-key features were retired. Free developer tools can disappear even when they are popular.

title: Cursor closed new student discount sign-ups
summary: The legacy student discount was discontinued for new applicants; existing students retained access until their plan ended. Many 2025 guides still describe the old offer.

title: GitHub Copilot moved to usage-based billing
summary: Copilot plans changed how usage and premium requests are counted. The free plan still exists, but the old assumptions about unlimited access do not apply.
